propositions: Manual attempt scheduling in _pai_structured must be replaced with a single bounded Agent operation composing the S1 output-policy adapter while preserving full history and input authorization

Wire-context projection via HistoryProcessor must include a failed ModelResponse on retry only when response tokens plus output reserve fit the model window; else omit wholly without mutation to stored state
Authoritative-input overflow must raise ContextWindowExceededError without content shortening when input plus effective max tokens exceeds window
Truncation-triggered concision guard must apply only to prompted output mode, send a specific concision instruction, and share one output-retry counter with parse/validation retries

Request budget must combine base allowance (ceil(eff_max_iter/2)) with output-retry allowance computed once with no per-attempt reset, keeping returned req_limit as bare base for telemetry and banking inverse
NativeOutput branch must remain unchanged in mode selection and terminal truncation handling, running under shared bounded operation with original guard_capability attached (not concision guard)
